projects.name: RAG Chatbot over PDFs with Citations
bullets: Built a RAG chatbot over 200+ PDFs using LangChain, FAISS and a cross-encoder re-ranker, answering with page-level citations and a refusal for out-of-scope queries.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Research Assistant (LangGraph)
bullets: Built a multi-agent research assistant in LangGraph (planner, researcher, writer, reviewer) with tool calling, step limits, a reviewer feedback loop and human approval.
Cut factual errors by ~60% vs a single-agent baseline on a 10-topic evaluation set, tracking cost and latency per node with LangSmith.

projects.name: End-to-End Card Fraud Detection System
bullets: Built a real-time fraud scoring API (LightGBM + FastAPI) on a 0.17%-positive dataset, achieving PR-AUC 0.86 and catching 82% of fraud value at a 1% alert rate.
Implemented cost-based thresholds, SHAP reason codes and weekly PSI drift monitoring; containerised with Docker.

projects.name: Text-to-SQL Analytics Assistant
bullets: Built a text-to-SQL assistant with schema retrieval, sqlglot validation (SELECT-only, table allow-list, row limits) and self-correction, reaching 78% execution accuracy on a 40-question benchmark.
Added an auto-generated chart and LLM insight summary; deployed on Streamlit with a read-only database role.

projects.name: AI Resume Screener & Job Matcher
bullets: Built an LLM-powered resume screener with structured extraction (Pydantic), skill normalisation and an explainable match score combining embeddings and must-have coverage.
Added bias safeguards: PII redaction before scoring and counterfactual name/gender swap tests (score delta < 1 point).

projects.name: LLM & RAG Evaluation Harness
bullets: Built a RAG evaluation harness (recall@k, MRR, LLM-judge faithfulness calibrated to human labels, κ = 0.71) with cached runs, regression reports and a CI quality gate.
Used it to compare 6 retrieval configurations, improving faithfulness by +11 points while cutting cost per query by 35%.

projects.name: Support Ticket Triage & Reply Copilot
bullets: Built a ticket triage system (TF-IDF/DistilBERT with LLM fallback) reaching 0.89 macro-F1 across 6 intents, with PII masking and confidence-based routing.
Added a RAG reply copilot whose drafts were sent with minor edits 72% of the time in testing, cutting handling time by about 40%.

projects.name: Invoice & KYC Document Extraction Pipeline
bullets: Built a document extraction pipeline (OCR + LLM structured output + Pydantic validation) achieving 96% field-level F1 on 50 invoices and 78% straight-through processing.
Implemented cross-field validation (sum checks, GSTIN format) and confidence-based routing to a human review queue.

projects.name: Fine-Tune a Small LLM with LoRA / QLoRA
bullets: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-1.5B with QLoRA on 2.4k ticket examples, raising intent accuracy from 71% (few-shot base) to 92% with 99.6% valid JSON, served at about 3× lower latency than a hosted API.
Published the adapter and model card on Hugging Face, with an evaluation comparing zero-shot, few-shot and fine-tuned variants.

projects.name: Build an MCP Server and Connect an Agent
bullets: Built an MCP server (Python, FastMCP) exposing typed tools and resources to LLM agents, with input validation, read/write separation, confirmation for writes and full audit logging.
Tested prompt-injection resilience and wrote end-to-end tests for agent-driven tool use.

projects.name: Chat Assistant & Customer Support Agent
bullets: Built a banking FAQ chat assistant and a policy-grounded support agent on Microsoft Foundry (Python, Foundry SDK, file search), with conversation memory, rate-limit handling and logging.

projects.name: Voice Feedback Analyzer (BFSI)
bullets: Built a BFSI voice-feedback analytics pipeline on Microsoft Foundry: Azure Speech transcription, Azure Language sentiment, key-phrase and summary extraction, LLM-drafted replies read back with neural TTS, and CSV reporting.

projects.name: Image Describer & Generator
bullets: Built a Python vision app on Microsoft Foundry that captions images and answers follow-up visual questions with a multimodal model, and generates marketing images with GPT-Image, with content-filter handling.

projects.name: Invoice Data Extractor
bullets: Built an invoice-extraction pipeline with Azure Content Understanding (custom schema, confidence-based human review) that converts PDF invoices into validated JSON and CSV.
